name: my-personal-policy
notes: PERSONAL policy template -- copy this file to assistant/my_policy.json (gitignored, so your real edits are never committed or lost in a repo update) and edit the numbers above to reflect your own risk tolerance (e.g. max_position_pct, max_total_exposure_pct, allow_new_positions). Point the CLI at your copy with --policy assistant/my_policy.json, or set it in the Streamlit sidebar's 'Policy file' field. `version`/`name` are given a distinct identity here so this file is never mistaken for the project default. Every proposal is bound to a fingerprint of the FULL policy content (not just the version string) -- editing any risk limit invalidates outstanding proposals automatically, even if you forget to bump the version, so proposals always re-validate against the policy that's actually active.
